'''Oecax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] who lived at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked in the [[Nashal cantina]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Oecax appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
